# Purpose

- This standard operating procedure (SOP) describes the process of preparing, receiving, storing and recording fecal samples in the DP-Next study.

# Scope

- All eligible participants are instructed to collect (x?) stool samples prior to CID1 (Deep phenotyping - visit 1). Patient are provided with a sample kit and detailed written instructions for collecting the stool samples. <!-- something about the specific kit that we are using, short description, including how it is frozen and kept at home -->
- The patient will bring the sample to CID1, where it is received by the staff. The staff will ask the patient: “Have you used any antibiotics or probiotics within the last 3 months?” and the answer is record in REDCap.
- It is the responsibility of the person collecting each fecal sample to ensure that samples are correctly stored and recorded.

# Deviations, Errors, and Equipment Malfunction

- Deviations of returning process of the sample will be handled as follows:

  - If liquid has been removed from the tube: Add 5 ml of 96% ethanol to the tube and record this in REDCap.

  - If the sample is not returned in the tube: Discard immediately.
